5.
OTHER BUSINESS

5.1
Community Garden Program Update

Update requested by Council at the January meeting.

Councillor Fictional gave an update on the community garden program. Twelve plots were added at Placeholder Park in the spring. The waiting list now has forty names. Volunteers built two raised beds for gardeners who use wheelchairs.

Members asked about water access at each site. Staff confirmed that rain barrels were installed at three sites. A fourth site will have a tap connected next year. Council thanked the volunteers for their work.

Deputy Mayor Sample asked whether composting could be offered. Staff noted that a composting pilot would need a separate budget request. The matter will come back to Committee of the Whole in the fall.
